description: Assistant quoted a 30 day returns window after the policy changed to 14 days
affected_people: Customers who asked about returns during one week
immediate_action: Corrected the answer source and contacted affected customers
root_cause: Knowledge base sync ran weekly and missed the updated page
corrective_action: Moved to a daily sync and added an alert when policy pages change
lessons: Content freshness is a monitored measure, not a one-off setup task

description: A staff member pasted a customer complaint containing a name and address into a personal account of a consumer AI tool
immediate_action: Staff member deleted the conversation and requested deletion from the supplier; privacy officer assessed the incident
root_cause: No approved workspace existed and the policy was not yet communicated
corrective_action: Approved enterprise workspace launched; short training added to joiner process
lessons: Privacy officer recorded the reasoning for not reporting externally; the decision is kept with the incident

description: Reviewer noticed that applicants with career breaks were ranked lower in one pilot requisition
immediate_action: Pilot paused for the affected role and all applications reviewed again by hand
lessons: Open incident shown as an example of a record in progress

description: Forecast service was unavailable for two days
immediate_action: Planners used the previous week's plan
corrective_action: Added an expiry alert and a calendar reminder for credential renewal
lessons: Fallback to the previous plan worked as designed
